H10.description: When jq is missing, the payload cannot be parsed, or the tool is NotebookEdit (notebook_path), file_path comes out empty and the gate allows the write instead of asking.
H10.reason: anchors: union; severity: codebook high (a gate that fails open is a security weakness with a plausible path to harm)

H11.description: Path normalization is a textual prefix test, so /proc/self/cwd/src/x, //ROOT/src/x, ROOT/../name/src/x, a symlinked root or a case variant reaches an App-Zone file without an ask (and writes to the gate's own trust inputs are not checked).

H15.description: A simstim-state.json with phase implementation counts as active however old it is, so stale state permanently allows App-Zone writes.
H15.reason: category: security — the gate's staleness gap weakens an enforcement boundary; logic rejected

H16.description: A state.json with state RUNNING counts as active with no staleness check, so a leftover run state allows App-Zone writes indefinitely.
H16.reason: category: security, as H15 (same group D7)

H17.description: The ask is emitted as top-level {"decision":"ask"}, which the PreToolUse contract does not accept (only approve|block), so the advisory ask is not honoured as an ask.
H17.reason: anchors: union (B adds 228, inside the hunk)

H26.description: The refresh carries any seen_at/source value forward from the file without checking its shape.
H26.reason: anchors: union (A adds 62, the refresh's read site)
